full_prompt_en: A square pen-and-wash illustration shows a mouse-headed gentleman seated in an ornate Victorian room with warm ochre patterned walls. He occupies the left-center in a gray upholstered chair, wearing a tall black top hat, black formal coat, pale shirt and pointed black shoes. His narrow gray muzzle angles toward the right, and one small dark eye regards a thin object held in his gloved-looking pale hands. One leg crosses over the other, creating a sharp diagonal above the pale tiled floor. The wall behind him is densely covered in curling floral motifs drawn with fine brown and black lines. Two small framed pictures hang high above the chair and side table, their tiny contents deliberately indistinct. At the right of the figure, a narrow wooden table holds a delicate two-arm candlestick and a few low objects. A dark architectural frame and leafy cluster press against the far right edge, while a tall patterned vessel stands near the lower left. Pale light falls from the right across the floor tiles, leaving soft striped shadows beneath the chair and shoes. The mouse face is built with countless short gray strokes, in contrast to the gentleman's broad black clothing, whose folds are picked out by restrained light lines. Brown hatching, stippling and thin ink contours give the upholstery, wallpaper and furnishings a worn engraved quality; limited gray washes add volume without erasing the drawing. The overall composition is still and slightly absurd, setting a dark formal silhouette against a richly patterned golden interior.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形钢笔淡彩插画呈现一名鼠头绅士坐在暖赭色花纹墙面的维多利亚式房间里。他位于左侧中央的灰色软垫椅上，戴高黑礼帽，穿黑色正式外套、浅色衬衫和尖头黑鞋。狭长灰色口鼻朝向右侧，一只深色小眼睛看着他浅色、仿佛戴手套的手中所持细物。一条腿搭在另一条腿上，在浅色地砖上方形成尖锐斜线。他身后的墙面密布卷曲花卉纹样，由纤细棕黑线描出。椅子与边桌上方高处挂着两幅小画，画中细小内容并不清楚。人物右侧，一张狭窄木桌放着精巧的双臂烛台和几件低矮小物。深色建筑框架与叶丛挤在最右边缘，一只高而带花纹的器皿立在左下附近。浅光从右侧落在地砖上，在椅子和鞋下留下柔和条状阴影。鼠脸由无数短灰线塑成，与绅士宽阔的黑色衣服形成对比，衣褶只由克制的浅线挑出。棕色排线、点描与细墨轮廓让软垫、墙纸和家具呈现磨旧版画般质地；少量灰色水洗增加体积，却不盖掉线描。整体构图静止且略带荒诞，以深色正式剪影衬托花纹繁密的金色室内空间。
style_prompt_en: A finely engraved pen-and-wash illustration sets dense decorative linework against broad, nearly solid black masses. Warm ochre and parchment tones fill the ground, while charcoal, cool gray and small pale highlights establish the main value structure. Intricate curling marks, hatching and stippling enrich surfaces without turning them into smooth gradients. A few pale areas are modeled through short repeated strokes; dark planes receive only sparse light edge marks, preserving a strong graphic silhouette. Illumination feels soft and directional, creating low striped shadows and a quiet glow on the lighter ground. The composition alternates compact detail with simpler dark shapes, giving the image an antique, whimsical and faintly uncanny character.
style_prompt_zh: 精细的钢笔淡彩插画把密集装饰线描与几乎整块的黑色体量相对。暖赭与羊皮纸色填满底面，炭黑、冷灰和少量浅色高光建立主要明度结构。繁复卷线、排线和点描丰富表面，却不把它们变成平滑渐层。少数浅色区域通过重复短笔塑形；深色平面只接受稀疏的亮边线，保持强烈的图形剪影。照明柔和而有方向，在较浅底面上形成低矮条影和安静光泽。构图让紧密细节与更简洁的暗形交替，赋予画面古旧、诙谐而隐约奇异的气质。
theme_en: A top-hatted mouse gentleman seated in an ornate ochre Victorian room
theme_zh: 戴高礼帽的鼠绅士坐在赭黄色维多利亚式房间里
name: Thomas Theodor Heine
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
